# §1/0 — 0/1 = / ≠ 1/0

## #0 — The completed figure faces its condition

T1 has made the sixfold available as a placed and directed figure. Its completion now turns toward the condition from which every placement was made. In native QL, `0` is the singular One, `1` the polyvalent All, and `/` their relating activity. The orientation `0/1` carries the One into manifestation; `1/0` carries manifestation toward recognition of its condition. The phase-flip operates their meeting.

The input is the completed figure together with its source relation. The result keeps the figure and changes how it is entered: from the achieved toward the given, from circumference toward centre. [A11](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A11-The-Two-Ones-0-One-1-All.md) **defines** the two offices, while [A12](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A12-Mono-Poly-One-All-Whole-Many.md) **grounds** their reciprocal dependency. The One depends on the All for manifestation; the All depends on the One for being and coherence. The turn makes this dependency recognisable within what has already become definite.

The [Binary Explication's §1/0 hinge](../../episteme/sources/internal-corpus/taylor/taylor-2026-binary-explication/taylor-2026-binary-explication.md) **sources** this operation between T1 geometry and T0 onto-logic. Its slash is active at the point where a placed description begins to read its own relation to what it describes.

## #1 — The copula retains identity and reversal

The source writes the hinge as

$$
0/1\ =\ /\ \ne\ 1/0.
$$

The spaced display preserves its source heading. It is a QL copular construction: the two orientations are held as the same structure and as different phases. The slash between equality and non-equality retains that joint reading. Its inputs remain distinct enough for the inverse to do work, while their identity lets that work return to the same field.

As ordered notation, inversion sends `(0,1)` to `(1,0)` and sends it back on a second application. It preserves the two terms and reverses their offices. As real-number arithmetic, `0/1=0` while `1/0` is undefined. The phase operation uses the ordered orientation, so the native copular relation does not assert equality of those evaluated fractions.

[A02](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A02-Copula-Self-Identity-through-Difference.md) **grounds** identification across this difference. [A03](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A03-Immutable-Gap-Formal-Limit.md) **extends** its constitutive limit: representing the condition produces another determination, with its own source relation still active. The inverse can expose that relation without completing a final inventory of its condition. The turn preserves the achieved expression while reopening what its expression depends on.

## #2 — Both parents contain the whole in reversed coordinates

The source gives each implicate parent a complete internal field. In the `0/1` parent, the four local contents are `0/1, 0/0, 1/1, 1/0`, bounded by `0` and `1`. In the `1/0` parent, their order is reversed, including the poles:

| Internal slot | `0/1` parent | Inverse-phase slot | `1/0` parent |
|---|---|---|---|
| #0 | `0` | #0′ | `1` |
| #1 | `0/1` | #1′ | `1/0` |
| #2 | `0/0` | #2′ | `1/1` |
| #3 | `1/1` | #3′ | `0/0` |
| #4 | `1/0` | #4′ | `0/1` |
| #5 | `1` | #5′ | `0` |

These are the parents' **internal** coordinates. They differ from the outer table, where `0/0`, `0/1`, `1/0`, `1/1` occupy #1 through #4. Stating the coordinate system matters: a local #1 can contain the expression whose outer address is #2.

The table admits an exact finite description. If the forward contents are an ordered six-tuple `F`, the inverse tuple has entry `F(5−j)` at local slot `j′`, for `j=0,…,5`. Reversing twice restores every entry because `5−(5−j)=j`. One reversal retains six contents while changing their order; a second restores the order. The two applications remain distinguishable in the recorded traversal even when its final tuple matches its initial tuple.

The source's Structure/Formality cross-reading compares local pairings with their outer content addresses. Local `#1/#4` contains expression/inverse, the outer `#2/#3` pair. Local `#2/#3` contains indeterminacy/unity, the outer `#1/#4` pair. The implicate pole-pair remains the axis of both readings, although its two entries exchange places. [A18](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A18-Primordial-Symbolon-and-Its-Eight-Determinations.md) **defines** the complete field within which these nested addresses can be read. The phase-flip preserves that field's contents and makes their differing organisation explicit.

## #3 — Re-entry makes the phase consequential

The inverse is now an input for continued operation. A single reversal changes the phase; applying reversal again returns the arrangement. With `R` denoting the tuple reversal just defined, the sequence is

$$
F\ \xrightarrow{R}\ R(F)\ \xrightarrow{R}\ F
\ \xrightarrow{R}\ R(F)\ \longrightarrow\cdots.
$$

The current arrangement records which of the two phases is active relative to the chosen initial arrangement. It does not by itself record how many complete cycles have occurred. Retaining that history requires the sequence of passages, or an additional cycle record. This distinction gives the re-entry comparison an exact operational content: recurrence can carry phase, while accumulated history has to be retained somewhere in the process.

The Process manuscript **compares** this hinge with [Spencer-Brown's re-entry](../../episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/spencer-brown/spencer-brown-1969-laws-form/spencer-brown-1969-laws-form.md), where a distinction enters its own indicated field. The native claim is that the completed `0/1`, operated through its inverse, becomes pulse. The comparison is Argued from the Process manuscript; its attribution of oscillation, memory and imaginary values to Spencer-Brown remains a primary-passage task. The explicit reversal above supplies the operation actually worked here.

[Kauffman's iterant construction](../../episteme/sources/mathematics-logic/kauffman/kauffman-2014-iterants-fermions-dirac-arxiv/kauffman-2014-iterants-fermions-dirac-arxiv.md#kauffman-2014-iterants-fermions-dirac-arxiv-q001) **compares** two views `[a,b]` and `[b,a]` through a one-step temporal shift. Its housed passage gives an independent formal neighbour for retaining alternation and the view from which it is read. The connection **returns-to** [Movement 27](../../../section-rooms/04-mathematical-substrate/movements/27-s3-p2-mark-reentry-complex.md), where re-entry and complex orientation receive their distinct formal developments. Neither ordered reversal nor elapsed recurrence alone establishes a lived duration.

## #4 — The description recognises its describer

T1 reads the field through AND+OR: terms are counted, placed and traversed. T0 reads the same field through AND/OR: terms stand in relation under the slash. At an explicit pair, `01` can be read as a binary string with value one; `0/1` reads the two terms through their directed relation. The field supplies both readings, and the switch of operation changes what can become visible.

The parent makes the change especially clear. In the placed account, #0 marks the centre. In the proportional account, its content is `(0/1)/(1/0)`: the expression and its inverse already related. What looked like a point in the map carries the whole activity through which a map can be made. The same recovery occurs from the achieved parent in inverse phase.

The source names this turn from IS to AM, from third-person description to first-person recognition. The one tracing the figure recognises its own distinguishing activity in what the figure presents. The first-person position is not reached by assigning another property to the described object. [A01](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A01-Subject-God-and-Faithful-Definition.md) **extends** the performed definition through precisely this turn: the defining activity enters the definition's account.

This is the native subject operation, carried into the processual reading. Its experiential development is Argued, with an exact consequence: the description remains available while its claim to stand outside the relation it describes is withdrawn. [A23](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A23-Trust-Faith-and-the-Formal-Limit.md) **grounds** the dependency that is recognised here. The dependency was already active; recognition gives it a new office within the account.

## #5→0 — The inverse returns the power of relation

The phase-flip belongs to the full Process circuit:

$$
0/1=4+2=5\to0=1/0=4'+2'=5'\to0'=0/1.
$$

The first field unfolds; completion faces its source; the inverse field unfolds; its return restores the originating orientation. Each equality gathers an earned QL stage, and each arrow gives the passage its direction. The full circuit retains both a recoverable arrangement and the recognition enacted by passing through its inverse.

Here the prime glyph marks File Two's inverse-phase positions. File Three's Night-pass sequence also uses primes, with a different office. The [Process contract](README.md) **defines** this full-chain vantage; Definition and Quilt preserve the short `0/1 = 4+2 = 5→0 = 0/1` statement. The two chains hold different depths of articulation without changing the source relation they articulate.

[A24](../../../section-rooms/arguments/A24-Arbitration-and-the-Usurpation-of-Measure.md) **extends** the consequence where a determination has acquired authority: the criterion can return to the conditions it measures and become answerable to them. The formal inverse does not perform that institutional return by itself. It keeps the distinction available between an achieved account and the relating power through which the account can be revised.

The page **returns-to** [Movement 24](../../../section-rooms/03-two-logics/movements/24-s2-p5-zero-changes-role.md) and [Matheme](../README.md). The accomplished figure remains definite, its source remains operative, and the next act begins with both relations available. Inversion has returned the power to read from the other side.
